source_review.zero_budget: src/server/jobs.ts policy takes min(environment cap, database cap), defaults missing policy to zero, denies admission before INSERT/provider submission, and pauses provider progress when disabled or zero. src/config/server.ts defaults budget to zero and requires literal true for enablement.

source_review.ownership: src/server/store.ts scopes project/asset/job lookup by guest_id; API checks owned project before upload/detail/PATCH, checks owned preferred asset and project membership; media is reached only after ownership. Same-owner cross-project references and catalog samples are explicit exceptions.
source_review.private_media: src/server/media.ts streams R2 body, sets private no-store, Vary Cookie, nosniff and attachment for download. Hosted Vinext adds routing Vary tokens; Cookie remains present.
source_review.sample_accounting: LibraryView.tsx counts only assets with source generation; catalog samples have no project/source job, presets explicitly isPreparedSample, and Studio/Library label prepared media. Uploaded fixture is source upload.
source_review.apple_design: Agency and specific status feedback: preference is an explicit acknowledged action; inspection does not persist it; saved/retry/error labels distinguish pending and confirmed states; preserved buffers/revision conflict recovery protect work. Sample labels and generation-off status remain explicit. No rendered, keyboard, reduced-motion, accessibility or animation claim.
